_comment: Phase 9 (M2): trusted SHA-256 digests for locally-pulled Ollama models, as reported by Ollama's own /api/tags (a purely local call — no external network). verify_model_hash() compares a model's live digest against this manifest before it's trusted to serve a task. Regenerate this file (via GET /api/tags) whenever a model is deliberately re-pulled/updated.
